name: The Wall
description: Harness the power of the earth to raise a wall, blocking the way and proving yourself a mighty defender.

name: Killer Slide
description: Wrest for possession of the ball with an aggressive, high-speed slide tackle that conjures countless afterimages.

name: Coil Turn
description: Coil around the opponent quickly to create a wind spiral that blasts the opponent away.

name: Earthquake
description: Shake the ground by stomping down from mid-air and steal the ball from the opponent when they fall.

name: Quick Draw
description: Quickly draw close to the opponent and steal the ball before they know what hit them.

name: Spider Web
description: Spread a spider web on the ground that makes movement difficult.

name: Cyclone
description: Deliver a sharp kick that stirs up a cyclone around the opponent and carries them, ball and all, into the air.

name: Fake Ball
description: A dirty move that finds an opening to secretly switch the ball with a fake one.

name: Shadow Stitch
description: Create and control a giant hand shadow to catch the opponent's shadow by weaving through the ground.

name: Sumo Stomp
description: Raise your foot in a mighty sumo stomp to make the ground shake.

name: Horn Train
description: Charge like a raging bull and bulldoze all in your way.

name: Hurricane Arrows
description: Rush at a cyclone-caught opponent like a piercing arrow while the referee is looking away.

name: Spinning Cut
description: A sharp roundhouse creates a crescent of blue energy that blasts opponents aside with great force!

name: Defence Scan
description: Take in the opponent's rhythm at a glance and shut down attacks with precision.

name: Ghost Pull
description: Those who are caught by these ghostly hands that appear from the ground can never escape.

name: Doppelganger
description: Confound foes with an eerie double that blocks in your place.

name: Bamboo Pattern
description: Three players form a circle and all slide in at once trapping your rival like a bird in a cage.

name: Harvest
description: A double sliding tackle executed at full force that cleanly reaps the opponent's ball away.

name: Divine Stamp
description: Summon a colossal foot from above to crush defenders like a hammer of justice.
name_ja: 裁さばきの鉄槌てっつい

name: Mega Quake
description: Break the ground apart with a devastating quake that blows everything away.

name: Blade Attack
description: Slam a foot down to generate a strong shockwave that slices through the ground like a sharp blade.

name: About Face
description: Strike from behind with a sneaky knee, then snatch the ball while they stagger.
name_ja: 後うしろの正面しょうめん

name: Shooting Star
description: Jump high up using another player as a stepping stone and dive down swiftly like a shooting star for a sliding tackle.
name_ja: シューティングスター

name: Land of Ice
description: An ice skating move that derives power from the conflicting nature between its gracefulness and freezing might.

name: Clone Defence
description: Split into three and send one person to attack while the other two steal the ball.
name_ja: 分身ぶんしんディフェンス

name: Circus Block
description: Jump above the opponent to distract them while another player steals the ball.

name: Heavy Mettle
description: Harness gravity to turn the ball into a weight and swing defenders around like ragdolls.

name: The Tower
description: From atop a sky-high tower, call down lightning strikes onto the opposition, leaving them no chance even to cry out.

name: Photon Crash
description: Spinning in a flash of light, the ball is stolen in the blink of an eye, leaving opponents dazzled.

name: Gravitation
description: An invincible supergravity field emerges, manipulating gravity to render enemies immobile.

name: Dual Storm
description: Harness the fiery power of two, whipping up a scorching wind to snatch the ball.

name: Supreme Spin
description: Spin like a top to whip up a tornado and blast any approaching foes aside.

name: Fake Bomber
description: Steal the ball and swap it for a fake, tricking opponents with an upgraded version of Fake Ball.

name: Volcano Cut
description: A sharp spin kick, causing an eruption of flames! The wall of fire will blow away opponents and stop their breakthrough.

name: Stone Wall
description: Combine The Wall with God Hand to block charging enemies like a dam.

name: Super Sumo Stomp
description: A large foot appears in the sky and stomps on the opponent in this enhanced version of Sumo Stomp.
name_ja: スーパー四股踏しこふみ

name: Planet Shield
description: Summon a colossal planet overhead and crush opponents with a cosmic-scale strike.

name: Sigma Zone
description: Once locked on, there's no escape. Three players converge for this coordinated attack!

name: Double Cyclone
description: Two players generate a rampaging cyclone that ruthlessly blasts the opponent away.

name: No Escape
description: Raise up stone barriers from the earth, forming a narrow path of no escape before stealing the opponent's ball.

name: Flame Dance
description: Use fiery breakdancing moves to steal the ball from the opponent.

name: Asteroid Belt
description: Call upon a meteor shower from outer space to repel the incoming opposition.

name: Body Shield
description: Three players line up and support the player in front so that the first player can use their body to put up a strong guard.

name: Perimeter Zone
description: Analyze and profile the opponent's data to find an opening to steal the ball.

name: Mega Wall
description: Radiate the presence of a giant and halt attackers with sheer, undeniable authority.

name: Road Roller
description: Barrel through defenders with a crushing tackle to flatten everything in your path.
name_ja: ロードローラタックル

name: Sleeping Dust
description: Sprinkle a dreamy scent to lull foes into deep sleep and seize the ball.

name: Ignited Steal
description: Steal the ball with a fiery slide tackle. Its fierce momentum is nigh unstoppable.
name_ja: イグナイトスティール

name: Whale Guard
description: Sound a conch to summon a giant whale that devours opponents and the ball with its massive jaws.

name: Whirlwind Force
description: Rotate at high frequencies like a prankster's toy top, creating whirlwinds that are difficult to contend with.

name: Mad Express
description: A triple-train-threat that seems silly, until it hits: blasting opponents away with awesome force.

name: Frozen Steal
description: Obstruct the opposition's advance by freezing the pitch. Shut them out completely at absolute zero.
name_ja: フローズンスティール

name: Perfect Tower
description: Unleash an electrifying double attack on the enemy from the top of a looming tower.
name_ja: パーフェクト・タワー

name: Diabolical Cut
description: Execute a hair-raising roundhouse kick that sends out a diabolical shockwave.

name: Snow Angel
description: Freeze the opponent into a giant ice block using snow crystals born from frigid winds.

name: Barbarian Shield
description: Manifest a shield infused with barbarian strength to intimidate and repel any assault.
name_ja: バーバリアンの盾たて

name: Ground Quake
description: Unleash a mighty punch that shakes the ground, stopping everything in its path.

name: Desert Blast
description: Kick up a cloud of sand, blind the opponent, and snatch the ball while they stagger.

name: Am-Bush
description: Stay hidden and strike from behind to ambush enemies before they notice what's happening.

name: Gravestone
description: Hit the ground with full strength to make stone pillars jut out and send the opponent flying.

name: Racing Flame
description: Steal the ball with a fiery roundhouse kick, Taekwondo-style.
name_ja: 地走じばしり火炎かえん

name: Iron Wall
description: This looming wall is an ironclad defence that strikes fear into the heart of opponents.

name: Power Charge
description: Focus all your strength into a shoulder tackle and snatch the ball.

name: Vac Attack
description: Use a kick to create a tear in space that sucks in the ball and reduces its power.

name: Yo-Yo Ball
description: Kick to spin the ball and reel it back like a tethered yo-yo.

name: Rolling Slide
description: Overtake the opponent using high-speed backflips and steal the ball with a sliding tackle.

name: Stone Prison
description: Imprison the opponent with stone pillars from the ground and steal the ball from them.

name: The Mountain
description: A greatly powered-up version of The Wall that summons a towering mountain to block opponents.

name: Zigzag Flame
description: Run forward in a zigzag manner to start a fire while charging towards the opponent.

name: Dawnrise
description: Call forth a divine pillar of light using a rising kick to send opponents flying.

name: Duskfall
description: Call forth a dark shockwave using a downward stomp to assault the opponent.

name: Mystifying Mist
description: Conjure up a concealing mist which prevents the opposition from knowing that the ball has been stolen from them.

name: Hunter's Net
description: Create a large net that restricts the opposition's movements. Once caught, they are at the mercy of the hunter.

name: Runaway Train
description: Charge headlong into the opponent with steam rising from the head like a raging runaway train.

name: Whirlpool
description: Conjure a whirlpool strong enough to sink ships and steal the ball after the opponent is swept up in the waves.

name: Card Shark
description: Unleash a barrage of attack cards in a hyper-dimensional football clash, stopping opponents in their tracks.

name: Thief's Eye
description: Do a thorough scan to read the opponent's next move and steal the ball from them.

name: Cyclone Sprint
description: Unleash a tornado on the opposition and send them flying. Then, with the wind, make a mad dash straight for the goal.

name: Ozone Flayer
description: Forge the air into a bullet of wind, blast the foe away and steal the ball.

name: Killer Whale
description: Unleash a sleek aquatic assault, sliding with deadly precision to knock opponents aside and snatch the ball.

name: Pancake Defence
description: A high-speed, low-flying diving header which requires excellent synergy.
name_ja: かっとびディフェンス

name: Slice and Dice
description: Stir up a violent sandstorm to lower visibility and attack the opponent to steal the ball away.

name: Pincer Pinch
description: Two players slide in to trap the opponent like crabs brandishing their claws.

name: Spatial Portal
description: A foot suddenly juts out from a portal, catching the opponent off guard.
name_ja: ディメンションカット

name: Jumbo Sandwich
description: Two jumbo-sized players approach from behind and put a stop to any player sandwiched between them.

name: Master Stroke
description: Summon a mighty being that blasts forth a beam from its mouth at enemies.
name_ja: 最強さいきょうさん召喚しょうかん

name: Solar Surprise
description: Rain down blinding lights as intense as lasers, making the opposition falter in awe.
name_ja: クレイジーサンライト

name: Side Swipe
description: Close in on an opponent while teleporting through darkness and steal the ball in the blink of an eye.

name: Great Wall
description: Summon a Great Wall from underground to surround and block the entire pitch.
name_ja: ビバ！万里ばんりの長城ちょうじょう

name: Mystic Mist
description: Release a mystical mist that lowers visibility and steal the ball from a momentarily confused opponent.

name: Wall of Atlantis
description: Awaken the legacy of Atlantis' ancient power and drive the ball back with its immense force.
name_ja: アトランティスウォール

name: Dragon Storm
description: Spin a massive spear into a raging tornado to bulldoze through foes and rip the ball away.

name: Titanic Slam
description: Drive a colossal punch into the ground that sends a towering pillar of energy skyward, blasting enemies and rebounding the ball.

name: Grand Finale
description: Let out a shattering shout, forcing the opponent to falter, then seize the ball.
name_ja: ブラッディアンコール

name: Scattershot
description: Unleash a barrage of bullets that explode all at once, blasting foes away.
name_ja: 破壊弾幕はかいだんまく

name: Dark Space
description: Summon a shadowed dimension that drags your opponent into despair to break their will and strip the ball away.

name: Fractal Repeller
description: Three players work together to trap the opponent inside an eerie fractal house.

name: Hyper-Swiper
description: Run in a way that leaves an afterimage to distract the opponent while you steal the ball.

name: Pterrordactyl Swoop
description: Charge at the opponent like an ancient winged dinosaur swooping down with a cyclone in its wake.
name_ja: 古代こだいの翼つばさ

name: Tesla Coil
description: Infuse the ball with electromagnetic power to make it spiral into the air together with the dribbler.

name: Oglitteration
description: Mesmerize the opponent with a fantastic display of stardust and fireworks.
name_ja: きらきらイリュージョン

name: Jungle Jam
description: Turn the pitch into a jungle as you swing three players into a simultaneous attack.

name: Magnetism
description: Use the power of magnetism to draw the opponent's ball away and hold on firmly to it.

name: Asterocks
description: Smash the ground to fling opponents aside, then crush them beneath six massive boulders.

name: La Flamme
description: Block the opponent's offence with a wall of blazing flames swirling around your body.

name: Goopy Gloopy Goo
description: Whip up a mixture of gloopy goo. Vigorously stretch it out and mix in the ball to trap it.
name_ja: もちもち黄粉餅きなこもち

name: Fire Drill
description: A rough and dangerous move that blows the opponent away with a fiery jumping kick.
name_ja: スクリュードライバー

name: Overnight Fortress
description: Build up a daunting Japanese-style fortress in the blink of an eye, intimidating the opponent.

name: Floral Fiesta
description: Launch a dazzling fireworks display that mesmerizes both allies and foes alike.

name: Okehazama Ravine
description: This move recreates the scene of an epic historical battle on the pitch.

name: Acrobotics
description: Their moves may seem all over the place at first, but it's all a calculated move to steal the ball.
name_ja: 無影乱舞むえいらんぶ

name: Skytree Hop
description: Leap from a towering height and descend in a blazing arc beneath the crimson sunset.
name_ja: スカイツリーフォール

name: Electric Impedance
description: Send a jolt from your foot into your foe's body and snatch the ball when they freeze in shock.

name: Particle Accelerator
description: Gather atmospheric particles with a special method and use them to cause a big explosion on cue.

name: Valkyrie's Signal
description: With the gleam of a warrior maiden, charge forward to overwhelm your foe and snatch the ball amid a radiant storm.
name_ja: ヴァルキリーフラッグ

name: Tortoise Shield
description: Form an aura shell and strike with a powerful punch, sending the shell and your opponent flying.
name_ja: 正拳亀甲波せいけんきっこうは

name: Aurora Arrow
description: Harness the brilliance of the sun and release a luminous arrow that rips through everything before it.

name: Hunter's Spear
description: Let out a thunderous roar as you hurl your spear at lightning speed, striking your target with deadly precision.

name: Shadow Guard
description: Summon a swirling shield of shadow and slam your opponent aside to guide the ball back under your control.

name: Feather Duster
description: Spread your wings and whirl through the air, scattering feathers to blast opponents away.
name_ja: 天空てんくうの舞まい

name: Sordid Thorns
description: Summon jagged thorns from the pitch to trap your foe, then shatter the cage to hurl them aside as the ball springs back.

name: Defence Equation
description: Calculate the perfect angle and speed to intercept, turning every movement into a precise block.
name_ja: ディフェンス方程式ほうていしき

name: Fancy-Footwork
description: Float like a boxer and snatch the ball with flawless, nimble footwork.

name: Trina Tumble
description: Roll through the pitch wrapped in leaves, crashing into opponents and taking them by surprise.

name: Copy Cut
description: Read the opponent's every move and snatch the ball under relentless pressure.

name: Willy-Willy
description: Spin rapidly to unleash a willy-willy dust devil and blast foes aside.

name: Maestro's Call
description: Seize the perfect moment to strike beautifully and steal the ball with finesse.

name: Center Scythe Slice
description: Two players unleash simultaneous middle kicks, knocking opponents back with a shockwave.

name: Warsaw
description: Team up to spin like a saw, slicing across the pitch and barreling past all in your path.

name: Under Miner
description: Dive into the turf, spinning to upend opponents and reclaim the ball from below.

name: Waterfall
description: Summon a towering waterfall to block the opponent's path, embodying the grandeur of nature.

name: Volcanic Flight
description: Launch skyward on a volcanic updraft and snatch the ball while soaring at full speed.

name: Bindweed
description: Wrap opponents in writhing pink vines, squeezing them tight before slipping past.

name: Stealth Step
description: Harness stealth technology to vanish and snatch the ball unnoticed.

name: Rock Hammer
description: Call forth a colossal rock hammer and bring it crashing down, shaking the ground and blasting your opponent away.

name: Judgment Ray
description: Fire beams from a multitude of magical circles, delivering cosmic justice to the enemy.
name_ja: ジャッジメント・レイ

name: Phalanx
description: Form a shielded formation like ancient heavy infantry, shoving foes aside.

name: Psychic Lift
description: Levitate the opponent with the ball and hurl both away with telekinetic force.

name: Logicstical Sync
description: Combine sharp calculation and keen insight to orchestrate a flawless, unstoppable defence.

name: Fox Mirage
description: Run in a circling arc, kicking up dust to snatch the ball from an unseen angle.
name_ja: フォックス・ミラージュ

name: Flamey Mirage
description: Conjure swirling sand to vanish from view, then strike with a sudden tackle.
name_ja: フレイミー・ミラージュ

name: Owl Swipe
description: Eyes a-glow with eerie light, you slip through the shadows to snatch the ball.
name_ja: フクロウ・スティール

name: Horned Owl Swipe
description: Drape all except your eyes in shadow and snatch the ball with cunning moves.
name_ja: ミミズク・スティール

name: Ratel Claw
description: Lure opponents with a cute facade, then slash unexpectedly to catch them off guard.

name: Kulupe Claw
description: Charge forward, stop on a dime, then leap up to rake opponents with sharp claws.

name: Gyorom Claw
description: Fix your target with a massive single-eye stare, then swing your claws to snatch the ball.

name: Buffalo Crusher
description: Smash forward like a rampaging beast, sending foes flying and ramming them with sheer horned force.
name_ja: バッファロー・クラッシャー

name: Gandoran Crusher
description: Plow through like an unstoppable armored juggernaut and snatch the ball with brute force.
name_ja: ガンドラン・クラッシャー

name: Dandrol Crusher
description: Smash through like a juggernaut as you snort and charge head-on.
name_ja: ダンドール・クラッシャー

name: Dolphanus Splash
description: Swim across the field at breakneck speed and smash through defenders to snatch the ball.
name_ja: ドルファヌス・スプラッシュ

name: Garius Bounce
description: Launch off a cliff and crash down with a spinning attack over the opponent's head.

name: Gyrius Bounce
description: Curl into a ball and tumble through the air, forcing opponents to shut their eyes in shock.
name_ja: ジンリュウ・バウンス

name: Twister Trap
description: Whip up a tornado with nimble footwork to weaken the ball and seize it instantly.
name_ja: シューティングカット

name: Gravity Cage
description: Pool the power of three to summon a black hole, sucking in the opponent's shot.

name: Containment Field
description: Erect a circular barrier around you to create myriad reflections and stop enemy attacks.
name_ja: ゾーン・オブ・ペンタグラム

name: Frankenstun
description: Generate a monstrous aura and overwhelm opponents with a horrifying blow.
name_ja: フランケン守しゅタイン

name: Easter Island Header
description: Summon a giant Moai statue from a rising mound to lift and hurl opponents far away.
name_ja: もっこり丘おかのモアイ

name: Wall for One
description: Line up The Wall to block opponents' dribbles and turn into a moving fortress of defence.
name_ja: レンサ・ザ・ウォール

name: Ursa Binder
description: Block your target with force strong enough to stop even the fiercest bear.
name_ja: 必殺ひっさつクマゴロシ縛ばく

name: Formidable Fortress
description: Construct a massive underground shelter and lock its layers to prevent any enemy breakthrough.

name: Tornado Barrier
description: Spin at blazing speed to create five colossal tornadoes and snatch the ball away.

name: Red Hot Shower
description: Rain down a massive meteor from the sky, blanketing the ground in shock and flame.
name_ja: レッドホットチリ・メテオ

name: Last Lion of Defence
description: Transform into a colossal lion and snap at opponents to seize the ball.
name_ja: 爆喰獅子ばくぐいしし

name: Twirling Turtle
description: Whirl into action with astonishing speed and dance through opponents to claim the ball.

name: Foil Formula
description: Outthink your opponents with supersonic strategy and take control of the ball.

name: Deep Diver
description: Drag foes into the depths in a swirling plunge and snatch the ball with relentless force.

name: Fortress of Despair
description: Summon a towering stronghold of chaos to trap opponents and spread utter despair.
name_ja: ディスペア・フォートレス

name: The Stronghold
description: Conjure a steel-bound fortress to fire volleys of cannonballs and sweep your opponents aside.

name: Kraken Seaquake
description: Encircle your rival in a spiraling vortex and awaken the ocean's guardian to rise with a crashing wave and steal the ball.
name_ja: 海神かいじん・ザ・クェイク

name: Vigorous Stomp
description: With a wild shout and a mighty stomp, call forth a titanic foot from the skies to smash down on your foe.
name_ja: オラオラ四股踏しこふみ

name: Runaway Bull
description: Unleash explosive momentum and crash through the opposition in a thundering, unstoppable rush.

name: Metal Hammer
description: Smash the ground with a colossal steel strike to send a violent tremor that scatters your opponents.

name: Dark Mist
description: Spread a veil of eerie fog that unnerves the enemy, then slip through the shadows to claim the ball.

name: Dramatic Swipe
description: Spin with theatrical grace and conjure an afterimage that beguiles the opponent as you claim the ball.

name: God Hand
description: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

name: Power Shield
description: Generate a shockwave shield in front of the goal to repel even the strongest shots.

name: Fireball Knuckle
description: Infuse willpower into your right hand to block goal shots by punching them away.

name: Shot Pocket
description: Envelop the ball with a special barrier that greatly reduces its power.

name: Warp Space
description: Warp space to create a black hole that attracts all shots towards it.

name: Counter Strike
description: Smash the ball with a full-power counter punch, aiming for a game-changing rebound.
name_ja: カウンターストライク

name: Sliding Goal
description: Body slam the goalpost to make it slide away for a miraculous save in this barely legal move.

name: Triple Defence
description: Two players support their goalkeeper from behind to stop incoming shots with the power of friendship.
name_ja: トリプルディフェンス

name: Pressure Punch
description: Descend from above to punch the ball down, crushing any shot in your path.

name: Tornado Catch
description: Spin against the ball's trajectory to sap its power and snatch it from the air.

name: Toughness Block
description: Muscles as strong as steel can take any shot head-on.

name: Full Power Shield
description: Gather all of your strength to create a shockwave shield capable of blocking powerful shots.

name: Wood Chopper
description: Chop the ball with the force of an axe swing! Every strike gets slammed to the ground.
name_ja: 薪割まきわりチョップ

name: Whirlwind
description: Release whirlwinds from both hands and combine them into one to absorb and negate incoming shots.

name: Rocket Kobushi
description: Form a fist of pure aura energy and fire it to crush an oncoming shot.

name: Wild Claw
description: Harness untamed speed and leap to seize the ball with raw, primal force.

name: Gigant Wall
description: The goalkeeper grows bigger by sheer willpower and punches the ball into the ground.

name: Mistral
description: Summon a swirling leaf tornado to guard the goal and knock away the ball.

name: Killer Blade
description: Slash down with a scythe-like aura, cleaving every shot in two.

name: Tsunami Wall
description: The sea god's roar summons a tall tsunami wave that forms a wall to block off incoming shots.

name: Blazing Knuckle
description: Pound the ball more than 100 times in a second to repel incoming shots with full force.

name: Majin the Hand
description: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin, an Inazuma legend awakened anew.

name: Infinite Wall
description: Three players raise an impregnable infinite wall together in front of the goal.

name: Mugen the Hand
description: Summon innumerable hands to shield the goal, impeding all possible angles of approach.

name: Utter Gutsiness Catch
description: Absorb any shot with the softest part of the body and cushion the impact with mastery.
name_ja: ド根性こんじょうキャッチ

name: Fireball Head
description: Headbutt the ball with blazing force and blast back any shot with explosive power.

name: Aurora Curtain
description: Summon a shimmering aurora before the goal, dulling every shot with majestic finesse.

name: Table-Turner
description: Grab a round table-shaped earth fragment and flip it up in a display of sheer anger.
name_ja: ちゃぶ台返だいがえし

name: Flame Breath
description: Take a deep breath and release it along with fiery flames to weaken and catch incoming shots.
name_ja: 火炎放射かえんほうしゃ

name: Beast Fang
description: Thrust out both hands like a ferocious beast baring fangs at incoming shots.

name: Drill Smasher
description: Create a giant drill to stop the ball. Leave the opposition feeling empty, as if boring a hole in their spirits.

name: Clone Block
description: Split into three with ninja precision and slam the ball down from above with triple power.
name_ja: 分身ぶんしんブロック

name: Claw Slash
description: Channel your aura into your toes and slash through the ball, slicing it clean with a devastating strike.

name: Dual Smash
description: Two players close in on incoming shots from both sides in a perfectly timed combo block.

name: Double Rocket
description: The improved version of Rocket Kobushi that creates two fists of aura energy instead of just one.

name: Flower Power
description: Use flower petals dancing daintily on the pitch to reduce the power of incoming shots.

name: Swan Dive
description: Dive from above the goal and crush the ball with a body slam to stop the shot.

name: Triple God Hand
description: Combine the strength of three into one colossal God Hand for massive power.
name_ja: ゴッドハンドトリプル

name: Black Hole
description: Manifest a black hole in your palm to attract and catch incoming shots.

name: Safety First
description: Countless aura shields block incoming shots, ensuring the safety of the team.
name_ja: セーフティープロテクト

name: Wormhole
description: Conjure a portal connected to other planes, swallowing up any kind of shot!

name: Temporal Wall
description: One hand rises, as if freezing time itself, stopping the football's momentum and deflecting it away.

name: Procyon Net
description: Like the Winter Triangle in the night sky, a shining barrier of stars protects the goal.

name: Fist of Justice
description: A giant fist of justice protects the goal by punching away incoming shots.
name_ja: 正義せいぎの鉄拳てっけん

name: Burnout
description: Use fiery hands to block incoming shots and reduce the ball to ashes.

name: Ice Block
description: Surround a fist with an icy aura before punching the ball to freeze and stop it in an instant.

name: Majin the Hand
description: Call forth a blue Majin from your surging energy and seize every shot with all your might and unyielding heart.

name: God Hand
description: Face off against any shot with a gigantic right hand manifested from motivation, effort, and determination.

name: God Hand EV
description: Envelop your hand in a rainbow wave with the ultimate evolution of God Hand to block any shot.
name_ja: ゴッドハンドＥＶエヴォルブ

name: Dimensional Hand
description: A variation of God Hand where a dome-shaped aura bursts out from the hand to turn incoming shots aside.
name_ja: イジゲン・ザ・ハンド

name: Hammer of Fury
description: Focus power into a fist and swing it down angrily with the Majin's support to put a stop to incoming shots.
name_ja: 怒いかりの鉄槌てっつい

name: Soul Hand
description: Overflowing passion manifests a giant right hand. Behold the mighty God Hand!
name_ja: タマシイ・ザ・ハンド

name: God Hand X
description: Cross both arms to dash and lunge at the ball, catching it in mid-air.

name: Fiend Hand

name: Rat-a-Tat Pass
description: Rain down a furious volley of blows to tear through the opposition's defence and drive the ball straight toward the goal.

name: Pegasus Bolt
description: Smash the ball with a charged, skyborne blow to unleash a storm of lightning that tears through the pitch.

name: Heart Beat
description: Feel your pulse quicken and break through at the speed of sound, leaving defenders dumbfounded in their tracks.

name: Spin Out
description: Add an incredible backspin to the ball before launching it at the opponent, causing them to be blown away.

name: Tornado Tunnel
description: Stir up a strong cyclone and dive in, using the air tunnel to go right past the opponent.
name_ja: 風穴かざあなドライブ

name: Guided Collide
description: Harness repulsion and suction to hover and drive forward like a motor vehicle.

name: Transporter Device
description: A strange teleportation device appears above, swapping you and your foe's positions.

name: Eye of the Storm
description: Whip up a ground-shaking tempest to blind defenders and surge past.

name: Bungee Ball Burst
description: Extend the ball like a rubber rope and use its elastic energy to blow the opponent away.

name: Plasma Cut
description: Scatter out sparks that explode violently! Dazzle the opposition and make them cower.
name_ja: スパークエッジドリブル

name: Swallow Counter
description: Dive down sharply from mid-air to kick the ball in a curved arch.

name: Black Tide Ride
description: The player stands tall with arms folded as a whirlpool underfoot turns into a dragon and attacks the opponent.

name: Sword of the King
description: Take a dazzling sword and swing with all your might. Only one with a royal bearing can master this skill.

name: Format Disk
description: Spread a chaotic aura that erases everything in its path and sweep past opponents in style.

name: In-Line Stampede
description: Synchronize perfectly with your teammates and barrel through defenders in a single, unstoppable line.
name_ja: 無影走破むえいそうは

name: Easy Breezy Kid
description: Save the goat kid that suddenly appears on the pitch by executing an Easy Breezy!

name: Decoy Deploy
description: Summon multiple fake clones of the player and walk right past the confused opponent.

name: Air Cut
description: Coil around the opponent quickly to create a wind spiral that blasts them away.
name_ja: 旋風つむじの刃やいば

name: The Tempest
description: Summon a sky-splitting thunderstorm and let lightning crash down upon the pitch as the ball surges forward.

name: Forked Edge
description: Harness lightning as you soar across the pitch, ripping the ball away and sending enemies flying in a storm of power.

name: Shadow Sword
description: From a crack in the void, unleash a crimson-black sword that slashes through the ball and enemies alike with deadly precision.

name: Burning Claws
description: Tear across the ground with flaming claws and blast foes away with a beastly shockwave.

name: Demon's Bolt
description: Unleash a swarm of bats to draw in lightning, then strike your target with a shocking blast.

name: Hoopsie-Daisy
description: A delicate move for offence that uses an elegant display of rhythmic gymnastics to block the opposition's movements.
name_ja: ビューティフルフープ

name: Menacing Glare
description: Fix the target with a cold, cutting stare that knocks the fight right out of them.

name: Burning Bomb
description: Send a blazing ball rolling to their feet and ignite it in a burst at the perfect moment.

name: Z Slash
description: Break their balance with a sharp feint, slicing past in a flash that traces a perfect Z.

name: Desert Drift
description: Skim across the sand in a wild drift, slipping past the defender through a veil of swirling dust.

name: Low Scythe Slice
description: Unleash a low, sweeping strike that skims along the ground and cuts the defender off their footing.

name: Silk Road
description: Weave past defenders against the backdrop of a Silk Road sunset.

name: Major Miner
description: Spin hard, dive into the turf, and tunnel underground to slip past the block.

name: Hydro Flow
description: Melt into liquid form to flow around the defender before they can react.

name: Magmire
description: Cause molten magma to erupt and harden instantly, trapping the opponent's legs.

name: Mushroom Hop
description: Bounce off giant mushrooms to leap over foes and scatter spores in your path.
name_ja: マッシュルームホップ

name: Holograb
description: Summon a massive holographic arm to snatch and toss any defender in your way.

name: Jackknife
description: Feign a miss, then slice from behind with razor-sharp water blades.

name: Shiny Feathers
description: Call forth radiant wings with magic, and streak past your opponent with effortless grace.

name: Atlas Sword
description: Swing a towering greatsword to cleave the ground and crush everything beneath.

name: Psi Arrow
description: Shape the ball with psychic force and fire it like an arrow through the defence.

name: Look! UFO
description: Shout about a flying UFO to steal your foe's attention, then sneak by with the ball in a cheeky dash.

name: Diffusal Chord
description: Stamp the ball and unleash a cascade of notes to orchestrate a dazzling breakthrough.

name: Verdure Vortex
description: Spin hand-in-hand with a teammate, whipping up leaves as you barrel forward.

name: Horse Sprint
description: Carry two allies on your back and charge forward with raw power, bowling through anyone in your path.

name: Univolt Sprint
description: Kick into a lightning-fast sprint and plow straight through whatever dares stand in your way.
name_ja: ユニヴォルト・スプリント

name: Peacock Radiance
description: Fan out your brilliant tail feathers and dazzle foes with a burst of shifting rainbow light.
name_ja: クジャク・ブラインド

name: Phoenichias Radiance
description: Let out a piercing cry and flash your wings, stunning enemies with blinding brilliance.
name_ja: フェニキアス・ブラインド

name: Brachias Radiance
description: Unfurl wide, vivid wings and unleash a burst of color that overwhelms and blinds your foes.
name_ja: ブラキアス・ブラインド

name: Grizzly Smash
description: Loom with terrifying bulk, send foes scrambling, and crush them the moment they try to flee.

name: Moon Bear Smash
description: Corner your target and throw your weight down, trapping them like prey pinned mid-hunt.
name_ja: ツキノワグマ・プレス

name: Gryphbang Smash
description: Drop with a force so overwhelming it makes opponents tremble before they're flattened.
name_ja: グリフバーン・プレス

name: Serow Cabriole
description: Race across the pitch like the wind and vault over defenders with a graceful leap.
name_ja: カモシカ・カブリオール

name: Redio Cabriole
description: Leap past your opponents in a sweeping, elegant arc as fluid and poised as a ballet jump.
name_ja: レディオ・カブリオール

name: Pamerio Cabriole
description: Corner your opponent on a cliff, then vault past while sending them tumbling down.
name_ja: パメリオ・カブリオール

name: Dohma Driller
description: Burrow underground and strike suddenly as you burst out at your target.

name: Zooma Driller
description: Tunnel like a drill, surfacing beneath foes to deliver a devastating ambush.

name: Gusfii Bomb
description: Drop explosive fruit from your horns to create a smoke screen that obscures vision.

name: Pegasus Charge
description: Ascend on immaculate wings and surge forward, breaking through in a blaze of majestic light.

name: Crimson Pegasus Charge
description: Neighing skyward, unfurl your crimson and blast through any foes in your path.
name_ja: ペガサスレッド・ブレイブ

name: Flash Dash
description: Keep the ball under control at blinding speeds. Pass by the opposition like lightning, leaving them thunderstruck.
name_ja: イナビカリ・ダッシュ

name: Sparky Spin
description: Toss opponents into a lightning-charged tornado to shock them, then surge past.

name: Divine Dummy
description: Radiate a heavenly light to blind opponents and burst through in one swift move.

name: Starstruck
description: Merge countless blue stars into a single streak of light racing across the pitch.
name_ja: ブルー・スターダスト

name: Bull Steam Ahead
description: Charge forward as a trio, kicking up a cloud of dust and trampling opponents like raging bulls.
name_ja: 特攻とっこうバッファロートレイン

name: Short Circuit
description: Lure opponents into a massive labyrinth and slip past while they're lost in your cunning dribble.

name: Dazzling Carnival
description: Unleash a carnival of color and light and send the ball dancing toward the goal with festive flair.
name_ja: サンライズカーニバル

name: Endeavor Rush
description: Race at breakneck pace, clawing past opponents with sheer grit and determination.

name: Grand Glow
description: Shatter the pitch with a brilliant flash, blinding all in your path and charging ahead.

name: Niagara Falls
description: Unleash a towering waterfall of energy that sweeps across the pitch and keeps opponents at bay.
name_ja: ナイアガラフォールズ

name: Ghoulish Glare
description: Unleash a spectral glare of burning purple energy that causes enemies to tremble in sheer fear.

name: Marshal's Light
description: Drive your standard into the ground to call forth a glowing sigil that sends enemies flying.
name_ja: ジェネラル・フラッグ

name: Peaky Breezy
description: Step and pivot with power to create a whirlwind that knocks enemies off their feet.

name: Matrix Eye
description: Analyze, plan, and strike to execute a brainy dribble that bends the pitch to your will.

name: Falcon Counter
description: Descend like a hunting falcon and whip the ball back in a dazzling, rapid strike.

name: Frost Finesse
description: Turn with effortless grace, holding the ball as you captivate the pitch with a picture-perfect flourish.

name: Hoopsie-Loop
description: Spin the ball with precise, hoop-like mastery to lock down opponents and clear a way to goal.
name_ja: セカンドライフフープ

name: Phantasm Dribble
description: Conjure illusions of yourself to baffle defenders and dance past them with uncanny flair.

name: Look! A Rice Ball
description: Alert the pitch to a mysterious flying rice ball and use the chaos to snatch the ball and break through.

name: Amp Beat
description: Pound the pitch with a rock-fueled tempo as you weave through defenders with unbridled energy.
name_ja: ロックンロールビート

name: Inazuma Drop
description: Use a large player's body as a springboard to shoot a high ball down like lightning from the sky.

name: Twin Boost
description: Two players kick the ball to each other at full force to amplify the power of the final shot.

name: Fire Tornado
description: Unleash a fiery shot from midair. The deadly ball enveloped in flames pierces straight to the goal.

name: Wrath Shot
description: Deliver a series of frenzied kicks to the ball before unleashing a super shot from mid-air.
name_ja: 百烈ひゃくれつショット

name: Inazuma-1
description: Two players move in perfect sync, unleashing a powerful combo shot in a show of friendship.

name: Dragon Crash
description: Harry the opposition with a merciless roar borne from a dragon's might.

name: Grenade Shot
description: Twist the body to build power and drive it into the ball all at once for a knockout special move.

name: Death Zone
description: Shoot from the Triangle of Death. Synergy between the three players is highly important.

name: Phantom Shot
description: Manifest eerie ball-shaped will-o'-the-wisps to confuse the goalkeeper.

name: Hawk Shot
description: Have your allies boost you skyward and fire a shot as you dive at blistering speed.

name: Meteor Attack
description: Slam the ball to send it crashing like a meteor straight toward the goal!

name: Snake Shot
description: Strike with a serpentine drive that twists and coils, leaving the keeper bewildered.

name: Spinning Shot
description: Rush at the goal like a destructive tornado. The move is difficult to control, but will never miss.

name: Comet Shot
description: Rain the ball down like a blazing comet, leaving a trail of light in its wake.
name_ja: 彗星すいせいシュート

name: Rolling Kick
description: Execute artistic mid-air somersaults to build power for an acrobatic shot.

name: Clone Shot
description: A barely legal move that uses ninja clones to kick the ball from three different angles.
name_ja: 分身ぶんしんシュート

name: Dynamite Shot
description: Blast the goal with an explosive overhead kick that shakes the net.
name_ja: ダイナマイトシュート

name: Patriot Shot
description: The ball is kicked high up and rockets to the goal like a missile.
name_ja: パトリオットシュート

name: Spiral Shot
description: Spin the ball to build energy, and hit the goal with a swirling, piercing shot.

name: Freeze Shot
description: Freeze your surroundings with a glacier stare, and unleash a fearsome ice-cold shot.

name: Cross Drive
description: A drive shot carried along by a cross-shaped aura formed through powerful kicks in two intersecting directions.

name: Teleport Shot
description: Make the ball vanish and reappear, confounding the keeper at the last second.

name: Psycho Shot
description: Lift and control the ball midair with psychokinetic power, then slam it into the goal.

name: Condor Dive
description: Leap up and dive sharply headfirst toward the ball, like a condor aiming for prey.

name: Run Ball Run
description: Dash atop the ball to accelerate it so it blasts for the goal with boosted speed.

name: Triangle Z
description: Three players come together to create a combo shot with a Z-shaped trajectory.

name: Utter Gutsiness Bat
description: Grab a teammate to use as a bat in an ultimate show of mutual trust.
name_ja: ド根性こんじょうバット

name: Reflect Buster
description: An unpredictable shot that bounces off fragments of the ground floating in the air.

name: Kung Fu Header
description: Utilize kung fu moves to supercharge the strength of a header shot.

name: Shine Drive
description: Unleash an impossibly bright drive shot that blinds the goalkeeper.

name: Divine Arrows
description: Infused with the wrath of God, the ball pierces through all things like a divine arrow.

name: Back Tornado
description: Rise high up like a bright blue tornado and aim for the goal using a spinning back heel kick.

name: Tarzan Kick
description: Swing from vine to vine like Tarzan and use the momentum to unleash a forceful shot.

name: God Knows
description: Banish even the laws of the universe into oblivion. This overwhelming power is nothing short of a divine act.

name: Dragon Tornado
description: A powerful special move that is a combination of Dragon Crash and Fire Tornado.

name: Dirt Ball
description: The ball rolls along the ground and builds power, turning into a crushing dirt ball strike.

name: Fire Rooster
description: Two players kick the ball with full force and make it fly towards the goal as if with fiery wings.
name_ja: 炎ほのおの風見鶏かざみどり

name: Inazuma Break
description: Three players charge the ball with thunder and launch it high for a lightning-like shot!

name: The Galaxy
description: Channel the power of God Hand to leap across the cosmos and slam a cosmic shot.

name: Emperor Penguin No. 2
description: A move that lessens the burden of Emperor Penguin No. 1. Summon penguins that take to the skies for the empire.
name_ja: 皇帝こうていペンギン２号ごう

name: The Phoenix
description: A flame-clad ball transforms into a phoenix that dives directly for the goal!

name: Baby Corodragon
description: He might be cute, but this baby dragon has a shot like lightning!

name: Dark Tornado
description: A dark tornado of forbidden power engulfs the goal with its cursed flames.

name: Eternal Blizzard
description: Sharpened focus summons freezing snow and conjures up a blizzard at the goal area.
name_ja: エターナルブリザード

name: Fireball Storm
description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm that burns all in its path.
name_ja: 爆熱ばくねつストーム

name: Tsunami Boost
description: Ride a massive wave and perform an impressive long shot that rips through the water toward the goal.

name: Death Zone 2
description: An ultimate technique, developed as an improvement for Death Zone. When three personalities collide, immense power is unleashed.

name: The Earth
description: A super special move created by David Evans that unites the will of all 11 players.

name: Rainbow Arc
description: A restorative long shot that paints a rainbow over the pitch.

name: Astro Break
description: Infuse the ball with multidimensional energies to travel at high speeds with a destructive rotational force.

name: Meteor Blade
description: Dominate the pitch with a foreboding threat reminiscent of the galaxy and shoot with a comet-like high kick.
name_ja: 流星りゅうせいブレード

name: Acrobat Bomber
description: One player makes an acrobatic flip with the help of another and uses the momentum to strike the ball with the hip.

name: Kung Fu Fighting
description: Each move is charged with power, then unleashed. A master's skill learned only by kung fu experts.

name: Double Grenade
description: Drop kick the ball with both feet for double the power and send it flying like a rapid bullet.

name: Gyro Head
description: Spin with the ball and strike a dizzying header straight at the goal.

name: Revolution V
description: The bond of friendship between two players stirs up victorious winds of change.

name: Heel Kick
description: Kick the ball up with your knee and hammer it down with a sharp heel kick.

name: Dragon Cannon
description: Channel draconic power into your legs and blast a fiery sidekick at the goal.

name: Dual Strike
description: The ball is passed between two players at high speed until it seems to split into two.

name: Legendary Wolf
description: The howling of a wolf, illuminated by moonlight, manifested as a pinpoint shot that roars across the pitch.

name: Emperor Penguin No. 1
description: A forbidden ultimate technique that unleashes penguins who peck at feet with savage force.
name_ja: 皇帝こうていペンギン１号ごう

name: Bed of Roses
description: Every beautiful rose hides its thorns. Graceful moves unleash this bewitching shot.

name: Utter Gutsiness Club
description: Swing your teammates like a club for a game-changing, hole-in-one strike.
name_ja: ド根性こんじょうクラブ

name: Double Wrath Shot
description: A blistering two-man Wrath Shot barrage that hammers the goal with relentless strikes.
name_ja: 二百烈にひゃくれつショット

name: Gungnir
description: Open a portal to outer space on the ground to unleash a shot surrounded by a lance-shaped aura.

name: Land Dragon
description: Tear across the pitch like a dragon devouring the earth on its way to the goal.

name: Tri-Pegasus
description: Three players combine powers to summon a Pegasus that rides to the goal from mid-air in a stormy hurricane.

name: Inazuma-1 Drop
description: Two players use a large player's body as a springboard to combine Inazuma-1 and Inazuma Drop.
name_ja: イナズマ１号落ごうおとし

name: Ganymede Ray
description: This isn't a handball, it's a kick! After gathering an enormous amount of energy, take aim, and shoot!

name: Leaping Thunder
description: Power up a mighty header and strike the ball with a lightning-fast downward volley.
name_ja: ジャンピングサンダー

name: Eagle Buster
description: Two players soar up like eagles to deliver a powerful twin shot from mid-air.

name: Butterfly Trance
description: Like a butterfly's flapping wings, two perfectly in sync players combine their powers and put the opposition in a trance.

name: Cosmic Blast
description: A double kick opens up a dimension to outer space and the energy is harnessed for a shot of cosmic strength.

name: Gaia Break
description: Three players' auras smash the ground apart. Ball and boulder explode in a brutal strike.

name: Spectacle Crash
description: Who cares if your glasses break? It's worth it if it makes the ball change trajectory!

name: Twin Boost F
description: A combo move that works together with Fire Tornado by boosting its power.
name_ja: ツインブーストＦファイア

name: Double Tornado
description: Combine spinning Back and Fire Tornadoes into a strike that swirls onward.

name: Atomic Flare
description: Imbue the ball with explosive solar energy and fire off a shot engulfed in crimson flames.

name: Security Shot
description: Flick the ball up and lock it with four keys to secure a straight path to the goal.
name_ja: セキュリティショット

name: Supernova
description: The strongest of moves perfected by The Genesis. Its power far exceeds the boundaries of football known to man.

name: Space Penguin
description: Launch penguins equipped with spacesuits off into space, who'll reenter the atmosphere and go for the goal!

name: Wyvern Crash
description: An improved version of Dragon Crash that combines the Wyvern's speed and power.
name_ja: ワイバーンクラッシュ

name: Wyvern Blizzard
description: A powerful strike combining the Wyvern Crash and Eternal Blizzard.
name_ja: ワイバーンブリザード

name: Fire Blizzard
description: This double shot pits the opposing powers of ice and fire against each other to form a swirling vortex.

name: Dark Phoenix
description: Transform a ball surrounded by dark aura into a phoenix to amplify its original power.

name: Triple Boost
description: Three players run in a straight line and kick the ball to the one ahead to create a triple-boosted long shot.

name: Neo Galaxy
description: Link your resolve with two teammates and launch a shot powerful enough to shake the heavens.

name: Assault Shot
description: Launch the ball like a relentless missile, hammering the goal nonstop.

name: God Break
description: A divine ultimate technique that uses brilliantly beautiful golden wings that captivate even the gods.

name: Megaton Head
description: Launch a header, hitting the ball with a giant hand raised above the head.

name: Steeple Shot
description: The ball flies high up into the air and plunges down at high speed while spinning.
name_ja: 通天閣つうてんかくシュート

name: Northern Impact
description: An ultimate attack that imprisons the keeper in permafrost. The power dormant in the aurora breaks the opposing ranks.

name: Fire Blizzard
description: Opposing fire and ice crash into one to form a swirling vortex double strike.

name: Cross Fire
description: Two players' auras cross and swirl violently, unleashing a stunningly powerful combo shot.

name: Tiger Drive
description: Crouch down like a predator hunting prey until the illusion of a tiger can be seen behind the player.

name: Excalibur
description: A noble aura engulfs the player's raised right foot, forming a massive blade that cleaves the field.

name: Hellfire
description: A special move that ignites the ball with hellfire through a powerful kick.

name: The Typhoon
description: Rise with a force that could conquer raging seas and fire a storm shot from the eye of the typhoon!

name: Whirlwind Drop
description: New version of Inazuma Drop where two players work together to execute a whirlwind bicycle kick.
name_ja: 竜巻落たつまきおとし

name: Thunder Beast
description: A jumping side volley that summons a thunder beast. Used to boost a teammate's shot.

name: Tiger Storm
description: Deadly special move that combines the power of Fireball Storm and Tiger Drive.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: A blue dragon king spreads its wings and roars, unleashing a fierce yet majestic attack.

name: Gladius Arch
description: Seven glowing swords rip through the air hurtling toward the goal.

name: Emperor Penguin No. 3
description: Summon a penguin huddle by whistling, and gather energy as they circle around.
name_ja: 皇帝こうていペンギン３号ごう

name: Grand Fenrir
description: Three players come together to revive the legendary Fenrir, whose bestial roar tears through the goal.

name: Odin Sword
description: Penetrate the goal using the aura of Odin's sword, summoned via a magic circle on the ground.

name: Heavenly Drive
description: The ball rises into the clouds and descends sharply, surrounded by light, as if dealing out divine punishment.

name: Samba Strike
description: Add spin to the ball using fancy footwork and shoot to a Samba beat.

name: The Dawn
description: Two extremely heightened powers fuse together to create the DNA of a new move.

name: Big Bang
description: This special move has three players working together to add explosive cosmic power to the shot.

name: The Hurricane
description: Mix a blizzard and storm together to generate an ultra-destructive hurricane shot.

name: Megalodon
description: A giant shark appears from among raging waves and attacks the opposing team's goalkeeper.

name: Paladin Strike
description: All body power flows into a single toe. A dazzling light erupts with the mighty toe kick!
name_ja: パラディンストライク

name: Banana Shot
description: Send the ball spinning sideways, bending through the air in a clean banana-curve toward the goal.

name: The Tube
description: A gnarly curve shot that rides the waves and surges through the water tube straight for the goal.

name: Gunshot
description: Twist the ball between both feet to add a spin that causes it to hurtle down from above like a bullet.

name: Fireball Screw
description: Shoot the ball at the goal while surrounded by whirling flames that burn everything up instantly.
name_ja: 爆熱ばくねつスクリュー

name: Mirage Shot
description: A mesmerizing illusion shot where a mirage makes it look like the ball splits into two.

name: Pegasus Shot
description: Faith in yourself summons a Pegasus. This is the solo version of Tri-Pegasus.

name: Unicorn Boost
description: Two players volley in unison to summon a unicorn that charges straight for the goal.

name: Jet Stream
description: Three players work together to conjure a cyclone that boosts the destructive power of the shot that follows.

name: Grand Fire
description: A trio of powerful kicks stokes roaring fire into a mighty ground shot.

name: Brave Shot
description: Leap into an overhead kick and drive the ball with a razor-sharp strike that mesmerizes all who watch.

name: Chaos Break
description: This chaotic strike that combines God Break with Fire Blizzard destroys everything in its path.

name: Astro Gate
description: Summon a massive black hole to crush all in its path, powering up Astro Break to devastating effect.

name: Double Jaw
description: A shot that approaches the goal in a zigzag manner, like fangs rushing to crush their prey.

name: Eiffel Tower
description: Launch a towering shot that celebrates your triumph in a French twist on the legendary Steeple Shot.

name: Slingshot
description: Stretch the ball out to its limits, and use the elastic energy to fire a high-speed shot.

name: Sweet Deal
description: Bounce the ball off a summoned card and angle it straight toward the goal in one swift trick.

name: Emperor Penguin X
description: An emperor penguin born from darkness. Its aura of hate devours all.
name_ja: 皇帝こうていペンギンＸ

name: RC Shot
description: The ball transforms into an RC car tire and cuts through the pitch directly to the goal!

name: X Blast
description: Use crossed feet to cleave through the ball and launch it like a beam of light forged from sheer fighting spirit.

name: Almighty Cannon
description: Channel God Hand's hidden power into both legs for a blazing cannon shot!

name: Dark Matter
description: Gather dark matter from outer space around the ball and unleash hell on the opposing team's goalkeeper.

name: Shadow Ray
description: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive ray in this move that unifies light and shadow.

name: Maximum Fire
description: Infuse the right foot with a blazing sword that rips through the ground on its way to the goal.

name: Prime Legend
description: The team's power crystallizes around the ball, and a dazzling twin shot shines forth.

name: Doom Rain
description: The ball turns into a weapon of destruction that rains down crimson rays of death.

name: Doom Spear
description: Add a powerful spin to the ball by pinching it between both feet until it transforms into a spear-shaped shot.

name: Doom Break
description: Enveloped with an aura of death, the ball turns into a weapon that exists only for destruction.

name: Shadow Ray
description: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive ray in this move that unifies light and shadow.

name: Celestial Smash
description: A cosmic shot that crashes with heavenly force as a storm of stars fall from outer space.
name_ja: 天空落てんくうおとし

name: Clone Death Zone
description: Create a deadly triangle with your own power in a fearsome clone version of Death Zone.
name_ja: 分身ぶんしんデスゾーン

name: Clone Penguin
description: Unleash the move using only your own strength in a clone version of Emperor Penguin No. 2.
name_ja: 分身ぶんしんペンギン

name: Zephyr Shot
description: Generate a strong gust of wind with an explosive run to execute a shot that's too fast for human eyes.

name: Doomsword Slash
description: Infuse the ball with shadow energy and shoot. Its effectiveness is that of a deadly blade wrapped in dark flames.

name: Emperor Penguin 7
description: Multicolored penguins form a mesmerizing rainbow arc as they swarm toward the goal.
name_ja: 皇帝こうていペンギン７

name: Jumping Jack
description: Jump higher than anyone on the pitch and shoot at the goal with full power from mid-air.

name: Katana Kick
description: Behold the sharpness of an ancient blade! A shot that cuts straight through the pitch.
name_ja: 伝来宝刀でんらいほうとう

name: Bouncing Bomb
description: Rub the ball on the ground for friction to create a heated bouncing shot with unpredictable trajectory.

name: Headbanger
description: Flip and smash the ball sky-high, driving a full-force header home.

name: Warhead
